reference.question: The product of string length $L$ (cm) and frequency $f$ (Hz) is the constant 12000. When the string length is 40 cm, what is the frequency in Hz?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Divide the product by the known length

$f=12000/L$. When $L=40$, $f=12000\div40=300$.
